source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Summarize the report for each failed specification. 3. Summarize the report for each advertising specification that was not tested. Example: This product claimed 7.4 channels, but only 7 were measured. The product's advertised channel count was not verified (spec#1: channel count). This product claimed 500 Watts but the measurements indicate maximum output was 350 Watts (spec#2: power output). This product claimed an S/N of 100+ dB:
Specifications test results
Specification Test Date Test Result
S/N 2005-10-4 Test failed at 70 dB
